Generating code with AI is easy. Trusting it in production is the hard part.

In this #InfoQ talk, #Roblox Engineering Manager Andrew Swerdlow explains how his team moved from Copilot autocomplete to autonomous, agentic software engineering.

Learn how Roblox built “Prompt to Prod” with AI guardrails, runtime sandboxing, automated rollbacks, and new productivity metrics focused on feature velocity and agent quality.

🎬 Watch now 👉 https://www.infoq.com/presentations/autonomous-ai-software-development-roblox/

#AI #AgenticAI #SoftwareEngineering #InfoQ
